name: firm-foundation
description: Firm Foundation — a daily discipline PWA. Single-file HTML/CSS/JS app plus Netlify functions. No build step.

scripts.check:functions: for f in netlify/functions/*.js netlify/functions/lib/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'functions OK'
scripts.check: npm run check:functions && npm run check:app && npm run check:boot
